import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int v, w, c, nx;
        Edge(int v, int w, int c, int nx) {
            this.v = v;
            this.w = w;
            this.c = c;
            this.nx = nx;
        }
    }

    static final int oo = 2139063143;
    static final int N = 5010000;
    static final int P = 1000000007;
    static final double eps = 1e-7;

    static List<Edge> edgeList = new ArrayList<>();
    static int[] headList;
    static int edgeIdx;
    static int startNode, sinkNode;
    static int[] dist, flow, pre, las;
    static boolean[] inQ;

    static boolean spfaAlgorithm() {
        Arrays.fill(dist, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
        Arrays.fill(flow, 0);
        Arrays.fill(pre, 0);
        Arrays.fill(las, 0);
        Arrays.fill(inQ, false);
        dist[startNode] = 0;
        flow[startNode] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(startNode);
        inQ[startNode] = true;

        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            inQ[u] = false;
            for (int kb = headList[u]; kb != 0; kb = edgeList.get(kb - 1).nx) {
                Edge e = edgeList.get(kb - 1);
                int v = e.v, w = e.w, c = e.c;
                if (w > 0 && dist[v] > dist[u] + c) {
                    dist[v] = dist[u] + c;
                    flow[v] = Math.min(flow[u], w);
                    pre[v] = u;
                    las[v] = kb;
                    if (!inQ[v]) {
                        q.offer(v);
                        inQ[v] = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return pre[sinkNode] != 0;
    }

    static int totalFlowValue = 0, totalCostValue = 0;

    static void runFlow() {
        while (spfaAlgorithm()) {
            int u = sinkNode;
            int f = flow[sinkNode];
            totalFlowValue += f;
            totalCostValue += f * dist[sinkNode];
            while (u != startNode) {
                int edgeIndex = las[u];
                Edge e = edgeList.get(edgeIndex - 1);
                e.w -= f;
                Edge rev = edgeList.get(edgeIndex ^ 1);
                rev.w += f;
                u = pre[u];
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int B = Math.max(n, k);
        int size = (B * 2 + 1) * n + 2;
        startNode = n * (B * 2 + 1) + 1;
        sinkNode = startNode + 1;

        headList = new int[size + 1];
        Arrays.fill(headList, 0);
        dist = new int[size + 1];
        flow = new int[size + 1];
        pre = new int[size + 1];
        las = new int[size + 1];
        inQ = new boolean[size + 1];

        edgeList.clear();
        edgeIdx = 1;

        // Read x for k nodes
        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            int x = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            connectNodes(startNode, x, 1, 0);
        }

        connectNodes(n * (B * 2) + 1, sinkNode, Integer.MAX_VALUE, 0);

        for (int o = 0; o < B * 2; o++) {
            connectNodes(o * n + 1, (o + 1) * n + 1, Integer.MAX_VALUE, 0);
            for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
                connectNodes(o * n + i, (o + 1) * n + i, Integer.MAX_VALUE, c);
            }
        }

        for (int _ = 0; _ < m; _++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int x = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int y = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            for (int o = 0; o < B * 2; o++) {
                for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
                    connectNodes(o * n + x, (o + 1) * n + y, 1, d * (2 * i - 1) + c);
                    connectNodes(o * n + y, (o + 1) * n + x, 1, d * (2 * i - 1) + c);
                }
            }
        }

        runFlow();
        System.out.println(totalCostValue);
    }

    static void connectNodes(int u, int v, int w, int c) {
        edgeList.add(new Edge(v, w, c, headList[u]));
        headList[u] = edgeIdx++;
        edgeList.add(new Edge(u, 0, -c, headList[v]));
        headList[v] = edgeIdx++;
    }
}
